proof_body:
by
  intro R _ Q x hQ hx
  obtain ⟨hne, hprim⟩ := Ideal.isPrimary_iff.mp hQ
  have hmem : ∀ a, a ∈ Q.colon ({x} : Set R) ↔ a * x ∈ Q := by
    intro a
    simp [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton]
  have hrad : (Q.colon ({x} : Set R)).radical = Q.radical := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro a ⟨n, hn⟩
      have h1 : x * a ^ n ∈ Q := by rw [mul_comm]; exact (hmem _).mp hn
      rcases hprim h1 with h2 | h2
      · exact absurd h2 hx
      · exact Ideal.radical_isRadical Q ⟨n, h2⟩
    · exact Ideal.radical_mono (fun a ha => (hmem a).mpr (Q.mul_mem_right x ha))
  refine ⟨Ideal.isPrimary_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hrad⟩
  · intro htop
    have : (1 : R) ∈ Q.colon ({x} : Set R) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    exact hx (by simpa using (hmem 1).mp this)
  · intro a b hab
    have h1 : (a * x) * b ∈ Q := by
      have := (hmem _).mp hab
      convert this using 1
      ring
    rcases hprim h1 with h2 | h2
    · exact Or.inl ((hmem a).mpr h2)
    · exact Or.inr (hrad ▸ h2)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (Q : Ideal R) (x : R), Q.IsPrimary → x ∉ Q → (Q.colon ({x} : Set R)).IsPrimary ∧ (Q.colon ({x} : Set R)).radical = Q.radical
